message: 言外
Well then, maybe I'll go do some shopping.
A-Azel!? I never thought I'd run into you in the Shiokumi Shopping District.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Aze--」

name: Melphas
message: 「Why, if it isn't Lady Azel! To encounter you in a place such as this is truly an inconceivable, rare opportunity」
If I remember right, this is that Melphas guy who got treated like a suspicious person at KiraFes.

name: Azel
message: 「It was not my intention. Prier was sold out of jelly」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, so you came all the way out here to buy some?」

name: Azel
message: 「Reluctantly」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel, you don't look so good?」

name: Azel
message: 「I am fine, it is merely a passing malaise. I do not care for crowds」

name: Melphas
message: 「No, no, surely the root goes much deeper?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Lady Azel. As things stand, you shall never become the beloved spouse」

name: Azel
message: 「I have no intention of becoming any such thing」

name: Synn
message: 「A sweet potato?」

name: Melphas
message: 「Pleased to make your acquaintance. I am Melphas, a man who looks good with roses」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, how very polite of you. I'm Synn Sakura, Student Council President of Ryuusei Academy」

name: Melphas
message: 「By the way, it wasn't 'sweet potato,' I meant 'bride'」

name: Azel
message: 「I told you, I have no intention of becoming one」

name: Melphas
message: 「Oh, please soothe this fever of love with your cold demeanor. I have been longing for your embrace, Lady Azel」

name: Azel
message: 「Keep waiting for the rest of your life」

name: Melphas
message: 「Let me swear to you. It is not for your appearance alone that I adore you」

name: Azel
message: 「Hey, why are you looking at my chest and nodding?」

name: Melphas
message: 「I will say it one more time」

name: Synn
message: 「I really think you're better off not saying it」

name: Melphas
message: 「To judge solely by superficial impressions without properly looking at one's inner self is a mistake」

name: Melphas
message: 「Those are nothing more than countless falsehoods」

name: Synn
message: 「...? Something feels a bit off」

name: Melphas
message: 「Yet everyone delights in scorning this heart of mine」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong. I hate that roundabout way of talking」

name: Melphas
message: 「Then let me speak plainly! If I were to compare you to something, yes! You are a lovely summer's day!」

name: Azel
message: 「That doesn't follow the context at all」

name: Melphas
message: 「And yet right now you are an overcast midwinter sky. Oh, Lady Azel! If only you were blessed with friends, you could truly display your talents!」

name: Azel
message: 「What nonsense! That leaves everything up to chance. I'll pass」

name: Melphas
message: 「However, you must accept it first. For that is who you are」

name: Synn
message: 「Um... Melphas, are you hitting on her by any chance?」

name: Azel
message: 「This guy isn't courting me or anything」

name: Melphas
message: 「Heh, so my meaning got across. What a relief」

name: Melphas
message: 「Until we meet again, someday, somewhere!」

name: Azel
message: 「He's finally gone...」

name: Synn
message: 「A-Azel! Are you feeling sick? You're completely pale!」

name: Azel
message: 「It's merely mental exhaustion. I'll recover if I rest」

name: Synn
message: 「But the flash sale at Inamiya is starting soon, right? You were going to buy that bargain jelly, weren't you?」

name: Azel
message: 「Indeed」

name: Synn
message: 「The aunties of Ryuusei Town swarm that place and turn it into a total free-for-all. If you take them on while you're feeling unwell, there's no way you'll snag anything」

name: Azel
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm heading that way anyway, so I'll buy it for you」

name: Azel
message: 「Urgh... D-Don't forget!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? You have things to buy besides jelly, huh」

name: Azel
message: 「Wrong」

name: Azel
message: 「I didn't ask you to. You're doing this on your own」
As she said that, Azel handed me a 500-yen coin with a trembling hand.

name: Synn
message: 「Thanks. It's the ideal place to train my flexibility and reflexes」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm off, wait right here, Azel」
Surviving a brutal bargain sale rivaling a battle against demons, I brought the Vandine Jelly back to Azel.
Afterward, worried about Azel's physical condition, I forcefully insisted on carrying her bags all the way to the girls' dorm.
Azel remained silent the entire time.
